title: Island Cruizer Boat Rentals

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: We offer boats with a fully covered top to provide maximum shade for coverage. We also have boats with partial covered tops for those who enjoy more sun. We have boats that hold 10 - 12 passengers. Our fleet is well maintained, ensuring that every boat is clean, safe, and ready for your adventure. We offer flexible rental durations. Whether you want a quick, relaxing few hours on the water or a full-day adventure, you can easily choose the rental time that works best for you. All our boats are equipped with essential safety gear, including life jackets for all ages and fire extinguishers. We also provide you with a quick safety briefing before you head out.
